class.name: VisionOSMeshTracker
class.brief_description: A tracker for a chunk of visionOS scene reconstruction geometry.
class.description: Exposes one chunk of the 3D mesh ARKit builds from the user's surroundings. Enable this with the [code]xr/visionos/scene_understanding/enable_scene_reconstruction[/code] project setting. Use [method get_mesh] to render the geometry and [method get_shape] to collide against it. ARKit refines chunks as it scans, so connect to [signal mesh_changed] and re-fetch rather than caching the result.

method.name: clear_mesh_data
method.description: Clears the cached geometry for this chunk.

method.name: get_mesh
method.description: Returns the geometry of this chunk as a [Mesh], or [code]null[/code] if no geometry has been received yet. The mesh is built on first use and cached until the data changes.

method.name: get_shape
method.description: Returns a [ConcavePolygonShape3D] matching this chunk's geometry, or [code]null[/code] if no geometry has been received yet. The shape is built on first use and cached until the data changes.

signal.name: mesh_changed
signal.description: Emitted when ARKit updates this chunk's geometry. Any [Mesh] or [Shape3D] previously returned is now out of date.
